about_the_game:
The Last Manifest is a cooperative horror game about a space crew trapped inside a ship that refuses to let them go.

You are officers sent to investigate cargo disappearances. But instead of cargo, you find failing systems, endless malfunctions, and the only document left behind by the former crew: the manifest.

Repair. Adapt. Survive.

Your mission is to bring the ship back to life and find a way home. Every mechanism can fail, every compartment can become a trap.

The ship is not on your side.

It changes with you. Doors close on their own, routes vanish, corridors stretch. Every attempt at repair only raises new questions.

You hear voices. Not all of them are yours.

The intercom transmits fragments of phrases, system logs write themselves. Sometimes it feels like you’re fixing what you’ve already fixed. Sometimes — like someone else has done it before you.

Fun on the edge of panic.

This is a story of repairs spiraling into chaos. One holds a flashlight, another tries to open a panel, the third accidentally sets off the alarm. You laugh as the corridors rumble — until the laughter dies, and everyone listens to the silence again.

You are not alone.

There are those who have long settled in these dead compartments. They move behind bulkheads, whisper from the vents, appear in reflections. They can’t really be called “crew.” They’re more like a part of the ship itself. And they are not happy to see new guests.

The Last Manifest is a horror story about those who were meant to leave, but never could.

And the further you go, the stronger the feeling grows that the missing ones… are you.

The manifest lists dates and surnames. They look familiar.

As if your escape has already failed once before.

And now the ship only invites you to repeat this path — again and again.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit version 1909, revision .1350
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2 GB
  • Storage: 20000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40000 MB available space

short_description: Explore a ghostly spaceship in this cooperative sci-fi horror! Repair the ship, collect vital components, and avoid lurking creatures. Uncover the mystery of your mission before the ship consumes you entirely.
